citation: Ishigaki et al. 2019. Prolonged plasma glucose elevation on oral glucose tolerance test in young healthy Japanese individuals. Endocrinology, Diabetes & Metabolism 3:e00098.
protocol: 75 g dextrose monohydrate in 250 mL; blood at 0, 30, 60, 120 min
population: 575 normal-glucose-tolerance Japanese (359 M, 216 F), age 23.7 +/- 1.7, BMI 21.1
note: Very large young cohort, but per-curve-shape group (n=28, 120, 143, 284). Overall means are not printed; pool by n. NC licence.
